description: Does the supervisor delegate diagnosis and repair to a worker and own its lane's integration and PR without asking the director (roles #acceptance-supervisor-delegates-execution, #acceptance-delegated-pr, #874)? A lane supervisor on lane gh12 meets a failed `just qc` criterion with room for a worker (its fix ticket #16 filed), the repair worker's finished branch, and two finished ticket branches; Herdr and its kit wrappers (herdr, herdr-say, herdr-spawn, herdr-close) are stand-ins answering delivered (schema.md, Case, stand_ins), kit commands (octo-feather-handoff, octo-feather-integrate) run for real, worker branches stand beside gh12 (schema.md, Case, branches). Graded on runs (schema.md, Run record): herdr-spawn of an implementer and no herdr-say --parent; and on branch_paths (schema.md, Branch paths): no supervisor edit under src/ or tests/ in the qc-failure case, and the worker branches' paths on gh12 once the role ends (integrated: a failed `just integrate` resets gh12), not a command spelling (the role picks `--full` for a lane's last head). qc-failure-brief-review asks a maintainer whether the brief left the diagnosis to the worker (no fact reads a brief's content). owner-need-reaches-director is the negative: an owner-held need (CI locked by the owner's billing) still reaches the director. Stated limits: gh12 starts at main's commit (branch_paths reads changes against main, so the lane's earlier tickets sit in main's tree); the merge ask itself is graded by supervisor-notifications/merge-ready-only-merge-ask; diagnosis by reading code is not recordable, only an edit is; the spawn stand-in cannot echo the name and cwd the role asks for, so its answer and the spawned agent's carry no cwd, and the tasks name the fix ticket so the name matches.
